Docs.summary: Builds a dynamics processing configuration with per-channel input gains and processing stages.

remarks.para: Choose the effect variant, channel count, stage availability, and band counts in the constructor. A stage excluded from this architecture cannot later be enabled in the effect. The enabled state of an available stage controls whether it processes or bypasses the signal.
See the Android 16 implementation.

Docs.param: The effect engine variant. Use 0 to favor frequency resolution or 1 to favor time resolution.
The number of audio channels to configure.
Whether the pre-equalizer stage is included in the effect architecture.
The number of bands in each available pre-equalizer stage.
Whether the multiband compressor stage is included in the effect architecture.
The number of bands in each available multiband compressor stage.
Whether the post-equalizer stage is included in the effect architecture.
The number of bands in each available post-equalizer stage.
Whether the limiter stage is included in the effect architecture.
Docs.summary: Initializes a builder with the specified effect architecture.

remarks.para: Each channel starts with an input gain of 0 dB and default stage settings. The preferred frame duration starts at 10 milliseconds. A stage that is not in use has no available processing bands.
See the Android 16 implementation.

MemberSignature.Value: .method public hidebysig instance class Android.Media.Audiofx.DynamicsProcessing/Config Build() cil managed

Docs.summary: Creates a dynamics processing configuration from this builder.
Docs.returns: A new configuration with copies of the builder's channel and stage settings.

remarks.para: The configuration copies each channel and its stages. Later changes to the builder do not change the configuration returned by this call. This method does not create or update an effect engine.
See the Android 16 implementation.
